fields.question: What are your opening hours?
fields.answer: We're open daily from 7am to 6pm, and until 3pm on public holidays.

fields.question: Do you take reservations?
fields.answer: We don't take reservations for groups under 6. For larger groups, message us at least a day ahead.

fields.question: Do you deliver?
fields.answer: No, we don't deliver: all orders are for self-collection from our studio at 35 Joo Chiat Place, Singapore 427757, during our collection hours (Monday to Saturday from 11am to 7pm, and Sunday from 11am to 4pm). If you'd like the flowers to go to someone else, you're welcome to book your own courier or a delivery app (such as Lalamove or Grab Express) to collect them from us: just give the driver your order number.

fields.question: Can I customise a bouquet?
fields.answer: Yes. Tell us the occasion, the colours and flowers you like, and your budget, and our florists will suggest a design with a reference photo. Custom bouquets start from $60 for fresh flowers and $45 for dried or soap flowers. Custom crochet pieces start from $80 and need 2 to 3 weeks, because every flower is made by hand.

fields.question: Do I need prior gym experience?
fields.answer: Not at all. Your coach will assess your fitness in the first session and build a programme around your level and goals.

fields.question: What is your cancellation policy?
fields.answer: Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours before your session. Late cancellations are counted as a used session.

fields.question: Is your food halal?
fields.answer: We aren't halal-certified. We don't use pork or lard in any of our food or drinks, but our kitchen isn't certified and our suppliers aren't all certified either.

fields.question: Do you deliver?
fields.answer: We don't run our own delivery. You can order pickup through this chat, or find us on GrabFood and Foodpanda for delivery within about 5 km of Tiong Bahru (their prices are slightly higher).

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: For orders placed in this chat, we'll send you a PayNow QR code once your order is confirmed. In the café we accept cash, PayNow, NETS and Visa/Mastercard. We don't accept American Express.

fields.question: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
fields.answer: Our Kaya Toast Set is vegetarian (it contains eggs and dairy). The Pandan Chiffon Cake is dairy-free but contains eggs. We don't have fully vegan food at the moment, but kopi O or teh O (without milk) can be made without dairy in the drink itself.

fields.question: Can I change the sugar level of my drink?
fields.answer: Yes. Just tell us: siew dai (less sweet), kosong (no sugar) or ga dai (extra sweet). Teh tarik can only be made less sweet, not sugar-free, because it's made with condensed milk.

fields.question: Do you cater for events or large orders?
fields.answer: Yes, for orders of 20 items or more, please message us at least 3 days ahead. We can do kopi and teh in airpots (serves about 20 cups each) and kaya toast platters. A $30 deposit is needed to confirm large orders.

fields.question: Is there parking nearby?
fields.answer: There's no parking at the café itself. The nearest carpark is the HDB carpark at Block 55 Tiong Bahru Road, about 2 minutes' walk away, with coupon or Parking.sg parking.

fields.question: Do you have Wi-Fi and power sockets?
fields.answer: Yes, free Wi-Fi is available (ask our staff for the password) and there are power sockets at the counter seats. On weekends from 9am to 1pm we ask laptop users to limit their stay to 1 hour when it's busy.

fields.question: Are pets allowed?
fields.answer: Well-behaved dogs on a leash are welcome at our outdoor tables. Only service animals are allowed inside.

fields.question: Can I cancel or change my order?
fields.answer: You can change or cancel a pickup order through this chat up to 30 minutes before your pickup time. Pandan chiffon cake orders can be cancelled up to 12 hours before pickup, because we bake them to order.

fields.question: Where and when can I collect my order?
fields.answer: At our studio, 35 Joo Chiat Place, Singapore 427757, during our collection hours: Monday to Saturday from 11am to 7pm, and Sunday from 11am to 4pm. You choose your collection date when you order, and we'll message you when your order is ready. Please bring your order number. Street parking is available along Joo Chiat Place, and the nearest MRT stations are Eunos and Marine Parade (about a 10-minute walk). We're closed on the first two days of Chinese New Year.

fields.question: Can I collect my order on the same day?
fields.answer: Yes. Orders confirmed and paid before 12pm from Monday to Saturday can be collected the same day, from 4pm. This applies to fresh, dried and soap flowers, and to crochet flowers that are in stock (made-to-order crochet pieces take longer). There's no same-day collection on Sundays, public holidays, or during the Valentine's Day and Mother's Day peak periods, when orders must be placed in advance.

fields.question: What are your opening hours?
fields.answer: Our studio is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 7pm, and Sunday from 10am to 4pm, for walk-ins and enquiries. Orders can be collected Monday to Saturday from 11am to 7pm, and Sunday from 11am to 4pm: our florists arrange the day's orders in the morning. We're closed on the first two days of Chinese New Year. You can message us here at any time: our assistant replies straight away, and our team follows up during opening hours.

fields.question: What payment methods do you accept?
fields.answer: We accept PayNow, and Visa, Mastercard and American Express cards through a secure payment link. At the studio we also take cash and NETS. Your order is confirmed once payment is received. Companies can ask for an invoice with 14-day payment terms for orders above $500.

fields.question: How long do your flowers last?
fields.answer: It depends on the collection: fresh flowers last about 5 to 7 days with proper care; dried flowers keep their look for 1 to 2 years; preserved roses last 3 to 5 years; soap flowers last for years as a decoration (the scent fades after about 6 months); and crochet flowers last forever. Each product's details explain its care in full.

fields.question: How do I care for fresh flowers?
fields.answer: Remove the wrapping and the water pouch, trim 2 cm off each stem at an angle, and place the flowers in a clean vase with cool water and the flower food we include. Change the water and re-trim the stems every 2 days, and keep the vase away from direct sunlight, aircon vents and ripening fruit.

fields.question: Can someone else collect my order for me?
fields.answer: Yes. Just give them your order number and the name on the order. Couriers and delivery app drivers can collect for you in the same way. If an order isn't collected on its collection date, we keep it for you: fresh flowers in our cold room for up to 2 days (after that they start to fade), and everything else for up to 14 days.

fields.question: Can I change my collection date or time?
fields.answer: Yes, free of charge, up to 24 hours before your collection date: just message us. On the day itself, you can collect at any time during our collection hours. Fresh flower orders can't be postponed by more than 3 days once they've been arranged.

fields.question: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
fields.answer: You can cancel for a full refund up to 48 hours before your collection date. Within 48 hours, we can give you store credit for 50% of the order value, since the flowers may already be prepared. Custom and made-to-order crochet pieces can't be cancelled once work has started. Please check your flowers when you collect them: if anything is wrong, tell us before you leave and we'll fix or replace it.

fields.question: Do you include a card with my message?
fields.answer: Yes, every order comes with a free greeting card. Your message can be up to 200 characters, and we print it in a handwritten-style font. If you'd like to stay anonymous, just leave your name off the message: we never tell the recipient who sent the flowers.

fields.question: Will I see a photo of my flowers before I collect them?
fields.answer: Yes. When your order is ready, we send you a photo here on WhatsApp, so you can see exactly what you'll be collecting.

fields.question: What if a flower in my order is out of stock?
fields.answer: Fresh flowers depend on the season and on flights, so occasionally a flower isn't available on your date. If so, we'll replace it with a flower of the same colour and style, of equal or higher value, and message you before we do. For bouquets of a single type of flower (such as roses or sunflowers), we'll always ask you first.

fields.question: Do you take corporate and bulk orders?
fields.answer: Yes. We regularly make event giveaways, Teachers' Day and Women's Day gifts, client gifts and grand opening stands for companies, schools and organisations. Bulk prices start from 20 pieces, we can add custom tags or logos, and we issue invoices. Please allow at least 2 weeks. Message us with the products, quantity and date, and our team will send a quote within one working day.

fields.question: Do you do wedding and event flowers?
fields.answer: Yes. We make bridal bouquets (fresh from $180, crochet from $280 with 4 to 6 weeks' lead time), boutonnieres, corsages, table centrepieces and ROM décor. We'd love to start with a free 30-minute consultation at the studio or over video call. Please contact us at least 2 months before your wedding date.

fields.question: Do you run crochet flower workshops?
fields.answer: Yes. Our beginner crochet tulip workshop runs on Saturdays from 2pm to 5pm at the studio, for up to 8 people. It's $68 per person, including all materials, and you take home the tulips you make. No experience is needed. Private group sessions (for example, team-building or birthdays) are available for 6 or more people, from $60 per person.

fields.question: Are your flowers safe for people with allergies, and for pets?
fields.answer: For allergy sufferers, our crochet, soap and preserved flowers are the safest choice: they have no pollen. Among fresh flowers, roses and our pollen-free sunflowers are the gentlest. Some flowers, such as lilies, baby's breath, lavender and chamomile, can be harmful to cats and dogs if eaten. Tell us if the recipient has pets, and we'll leave those out.
